column1: # Recovered function signatures for the engine's own API.
# Columns (tab-separated):  name <TAB> return-type <TAB> parameter-types (comma) <TAB> evidence
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
#   Typed coverage (repo task T10 / port task P1.2) needs to know what a call
#   RESULT points at, not only what the calling function's name implies.  Measured:
#   of 1,389 offset casts inside class-named matched functions, only 46 apply the
#   offset to the receiver; the rest apply it to a temporary holding a call result.
#   The callee's return type is the missing fact, and this file is where it lives.
# RULES
#   * A row is only added when the type is RECOVERED, never guessed.  A wrong
#     return type would not break the build (the code is byte-identical either
#     way) but would put a wrong struct name in the C, which is worse for the port
#     than leaving it raw.
#   * The evidence column names the fact that settles it.
#   * Consumed by scripts/retype_initfields.py (via tools), which uses
#     `igMetaObject_GetFieldAt` to type the field objects the `<Class>_InitFields`
#     family builds; more passes will read the same table.
# name
igMetaObject_GetFieldAt
column4: it indexes the `igObjectList` at igMetaObject._metaFields (+40 -> +8 -> [i*4]), whose elements are field objects; the `<Class>_InitFields` bodies then write +52/+56, which are igEnumMetaField._getMetaEnumFunction and igObjectRefMetaField._metaObject

column1: igMetaObject_GetFieldCount
column4: loop bound for the field walk; the value the `_InitFields` bodies add to before GetFieldAt

column1: igMetaObject_CreateFields
column4: constructs N fields on the metaobject from a MetaField ctor array (data/reflection.json's ctors); the `_InitFields` bodies call it with the class's own field count

column1: igMetaObject_NameFields
column4: assigns each created field's name from parallel arrays; result unused

column1: igMetaObject_GetChildAt
column4: igMetaObject._children (+52) is an object list of metaobjects; the accessor indexes it

column1: igMetaObject_GetChildCount
